Terms

Last updated: 10 October 2026

The short version. imy is for adults, for your own private use. Only upload conversations you were part of. Never use it to pretend to be someone to anyone else. Its replies are written by AI from old messages — they are not the real person, and they can be wrong.

Who can use imy

  • You must be 18 or over. The AI services imy relies on set that limit in their own terms.
  • One account is for one person. Keep your password to yourself; you're responsible for what happens in your account.

What you upload

  • Only upload conversations you were part of — chats between you and the person you're setting up. You confirm this each time you add someone.
  • Don't upload other people's private chats, anything involving someone under 18 in a sexual way, or anything that's illegal to have or share.
  • What you upload stays yours. You let imy store it and use it to write replies for you, and nothing else (see Privacy for exactly what's sent where).

How you may use it

  • For yourself only. Don't use imy to message, fool or impersonate anyone — not the person you set up, not their friends or family, not anyone.
  • Don't share its replies as if the real person wrote them, or use them to embarrass, harass, threaten or pressure anyone.
  • Don't try to reach other people's accounts or data, overload the site, or get around its limits.

What the replies are

  • Replies are written by AI, based on how the person wrote in the messages you gave it. It isn't them. It doesn't know what they think now or what they would really say.
  • Replies can be wrong, out of date or out of character. Don't rely on them for medical, legal, money or safety decisions.
  • Each account gets a daily number of AI replies. After that, replies are written by imy itself until midnight.

The person you're copying

They aren't here to agree to this, so imy asks you to treat their words with care. If you are someone who has been copied and you want that removed, contact us below and it will be deleted.

Looking after yourself

imy can help keep a voice close. It can also make missing someone harder. If it starts to hurt more than it helps, step away and talk to someone you trust. In the Philippines, the National Center for Mental Health crisis line is 1553.

Ending things

  • You can delete any person, or your whole account and everything in it, at any time from the account menu.
  • Accounts that break these rules may be suspended or removed, along with what's in them.

No guarantees

imy is offered as it is. It may be down sometimes, features may change, and it could stop running. We'll do our best to keep your data safe and backed up, but please keep your own copies of anything that matters to you — imy isn't a place to store the only copy of a conversation.

Changes

If these rules change in a way that matters, the date at the top changes, and the version you agreed to is kept with your account.
